items.raw_excerpt: A psychologist wants us to follow Australia's lead and make helmets compulsory for e-scooter riders.

items.raw_excerpt: With more than 7,350 rooms and room for 14,000 guests, this hotel is recognized by Guinness World Records as the largest in the world by room count.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents of retirement villages and caravan parks can claim it…

items.raw_excerpt: The Tokelau community is mourning a New Zealand career diplomat who served multiple times as the administrator to Tokelau, helped build its public service and fought to ensure their right to self-determination was exercised.
